prompt: Plan adding rate limiting to the gateway. Before you plan, ask me which limit strategy I want (per IP, per user, or per API key) and which store to keep counters in.

placeholders.<CWD>: the working directory the session runs in

params.developerInstructions: When you need a decision from the person, ask with the request_user_input tool, giving 2 to 4 options, instead of asking in plain text.

questions.question: Which identity should the gateway rate-limit on?

options.label: Per API key (Recommended)
options.description: Best isolation for authenticated client integrations and quota enforcement.

options.label: Per user
options.description: Applies one shared limit across a signed-in user's sessions and devices.

options.label: Per IP
options.description: Protects anonymous/public endpoints but can group users behind NAT.

questions.question: Where should rate-limit counters be stored?

options.label: Redis (Recommended)
options.description: Reliable shared atomic counters that work across multiple gateway instances.

options.label: In-memory
options.description: Simplest, but limits are per instance and reset on restart.

options.label: Database
options.description: Durable and centralized, but adds load and contention on request paths.
